A6 ghi master/<unit>.json (kem anchor + muc_chac_chan) local --out-dir NGOAI cay skill -> danh done -> `state-put` cap nhat state SAU MOI don vi (khong don cuoi phien)
A7 ung vien moi -> Q-INGEST (lan staged, gom LO duyet 1 lan); nguon flip xong -> Q-NLM worker tuan tu nap sau
A8 dong goi CHU DONG: nguong context 40% mem / 60% cung do tai RANH GIOI don vi (chat: max_units_per_session=6) -> checkpoint + note ban giao + NHA claim

sau luot chay: git status cay skill SACH (state/master nam NGOAI cay - doctrine B.5)
don vi done khong bao gio reset ve pending toan phan tru khi anchor vo

PHA 4: `rasoat-merge --in <out-dir>/master` dung duoc bang master, roi rasoat_phuluc.py --in <bang master> ra phu luc 03-07 (r213: rasoat_phuluc.py cung tu nhan khuon S6 nen --in master/ chay thang duoc; TRUOC r213 dong nay la LOI KHONG DUOC KIEM - PHA 4 sap that ngay 26-07)
bang master co o metadata trong (ngay/hieu_luc_tu) thi phai HIEN trong _thieu_o_metadata - khong duoc bia de lap o

DONG DOT: `rasoat-dot-check --in <out-dir> --dot <dot_id> --strict` rc=0 TRUOC khi chot dot.trang_thai=da_dong. rc=1 = CO PHAT HIEN (verdict du lieu), rc=2 = loi dau vao hoac --strict co phat hien. rc=1 CHAN dong BINH THUONG (da_dong) — nhung KHONG triet tieu duong dong HAN CHE: van duoc da_dong_co_gioi_han VOI DIEU KIEN chep nguyen phat hien cua cong vao gioi_han_da_biet (S7.1). Lenh CO Y khong co co mien tru: mien tru phai nam trong so nguoi doc duoc. QUYET theo `loai_verdict` trong payload, KHONG theo ma thoat: --strict gop rc=1 vao rc=2 nen doc theo rc thi duong dong HAN CHE bien mat. loai_verdict=do_duoc -> duoc da_dong_co_gioi_han neu chep phat hien vao gioi_han_da_biet; loai_verdict=khong_do_duoc -> CHAN CUNG, khong mien tru.
